'''Settlement Officer''' was a title used in the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

One notable holder of this title was the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] to [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]].
